verdict.rationale: A government business-formalities portal could plausibly publish an API with a machine-readable spec, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the Guichet unique offering a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The only API evidence is a probe of a separate state service (recherche-entreprises), which returned JSON data, not a spec, and does not belong to this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
